name: PT Aksara Global Development Tbk
summary: PT Aksara Global Development Tbk, founded in 2003 and headquartered in South Jakarta, Indonesia, is a property developer specializing in the Indonesian real estate market. The company operates primarily through its apartment and housing divisions, managing a varied portfolio that includes land, residential homes, commercial shop houses, and other real estate assets. Beyond its core development activities, PT Aksara Global Development Tbk also provides extensive construction services. These encompass the building of infrastructure like bridges, roads, and docks, as well as various structures such as residential housing, schools, recreational parks, commercial markets, and hospitals. Additionally, the firm offers a wide array of consultancy services, spanning business, management, property, architecture, landscape, interior design, and civil engineering. The company's business interests further extend to international trade (export and import), wholesale trading, and the production of building materials and construction tools. PT Aksara Global Development Tbk primarily serves middle-income families residing in urban centers and emerging second-tier cities. The company was previously known as PT Gading Development Tbk, before rebranding to its current name in September 2018.
